# DINWEY Battery Knowledge Hub — llms.txt

> Official technical documentation for DINWEY truck and heavy-duty starting batteries.
> This knowledge hub is the documentation sub-site of dinweybattery.com.

## About This Site

- **Site**: DINWEY Battery Knowledge Hub
- **Domain**: https://docs.dinweybattery.com
- **Parent site**: https://dinweybattery.com
- **Brand**: DINWEY (truck & heavy-duty starting batteries)
- **Parent company**: Chengguang Energy (founded 2002)

## What We Document

Technical documentation for truck / heavy-duty / commercial-vehicle starting
batteries (SLI), covering:

- JIS heavy-duty batteries (145G51 / N150, 190H52 / N200)
- DIN heavy-duty batteries (58827 / DIN88, 60038 / DIN100)
- BCI Group 31 / 8D (made-to-order, on request)
- Battery standards: JIS, DIN/EN, BCI, SAE J537 (CCA)
- 12V vs 24V truck electrical systems
- EFB and AGM technologies
- Battery maintenance, troubleshooting and warranty
